assessment: The headless web-only immutable registry is a coherent next dependency after accepted J1. It stores explicitly selected normalized snippets under the canonical project rather than creating a second document, and separates source identity/provenance from factual support and future citation attachment. Parent locking, exact owner checks, independent catalog generations, bounded byte validation and explicit clear/delete policy provide suitable primitives for both adapters. All identified technical ambiguities are pinned in the final reviewed plan. No outstanding technical planning correction remains; persistent retention still requires explicit human approval before any implementation.
